rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides SSH-based remote command execution and file transfer capabilities through four tools: execute-command, upload, download, and list-servers. Supports password, private key, and SSH config authentication methods with configurable command whitelists and blacklists. Includes optional AstrBot admin validation to restrict tool access to specific operator IDs.
